description_en: Configures the RDP, SSH, and SFTP options of a control policy
description_zh: 配置控制策略的RDP选项、SSH选项以及SFTP选项
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-protocol-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 61 --protocol-config '{"SSH":{},"RDP":{}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyProtocolConfig

fields.help_en:
The SFTP channel configuration. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is Disable.
At least one of the SSH channel and SFTP channel must be set to Enable.
If you enable the SFTP-only permission for a host account, do not disable both the SSH channel and SFTP channel for that account in the control policy. Otherwise, you cannot use the host account to access the target server through the bastion host
fields.help_zh:
SFTP通道配置。取值：

Enable：启用
Disable：禁用

不填则默认设置为 Disable。
SSH通道和SFTP通道必须至少有一项为Enable。
如果您为主机账户开启仅开启SFTP权限，请勿在控制策略里为该账户禁用SSH通道及SFTP通道，否则将无法通过堡垒机使用该主机账户访问目标服务器

fields.help_en:
The SSH channel configuration. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is Disable.
At least one of the SSH channel and SFTP channel must be set to Enable. If the SSH channel is set to Disable, you cannot log on to asset accounts by using SSH permissions. Proceed with caution.
If you enable the SFTP-only permission for a host account, do not disable both the SSH channel and SFTP channel for that account in the control policy. Otherwise, you cannot use the host account to access the target server through the bastion host
fields.help_zh:
SSH通道配置。取值：

Enable：启用
Disable：禁用

不填则默认设置为 Disable。
SSH通道和SFTP通道必须至少有一项为Enable。SSH通道设置为Disable后，将无法通过SSH权限登录资产账户，请谨慎配置。
如果您为主机账户开启仅开启SFTP权限，请勿在控制策略里为该账户禁用SSH通道及SFTP通道，否则将无法通过堡垒机使用该主机账户访问目标服务器
